Key points:

title: Cataloging images
text:
Example: minimum catalog
Image catalogs must include the following columns:
path|caption|credits|license|tags

paths are relative to the catalog file
tags are comma-separated labels for filtering images

path|caption|credits|license|tags
leiden-pliny/IMG_1200.jpeg|Leiden, MS Lipsius 7  in shelving box, overview of front cover and spine.|Photograph Neel Smith, 2019|Public domain (CC0)|Pliny, Leiden

title: Cataloging images
text:
Example: optional fields
You may optionally include additional columns for year and place.
path|caption|credits|license|tags|year|place
leiden-pliny/IMG_1200.jpeg|Leiden, MS Lipsius 7  in shelving box, overview of front cover and spine.|Photograph Neel Smith, 2019|Public domain (CC0)|Pliny, Leiden, manuscripts|2019|Leiden, NL|

local-image-viewer.html is an app for browsing and viewing images in your local file system. Open it in your favorite web browser, and choose a folder in your local file system. The app will find and images in the folder you are viewing, and allow you to display and filter them just like the web installations.

title: Using imageviewer with a web server
text:
Files on github??

Server needs: plain static files at those URLs, nothing more. The data files come from GitHub, so the image server needs no special cross-site permissions (CORS).

title: Image viewers
text:
The imageviewer github repository hosts apps for light-table and zoomable/pannable display of individual images. All the apps are implemented in self-contained HTML files that can be run locally or served on the web. They all support optionally cataloging images in simple delimited-text files.
In the light-table view, users can filter the selection by cataloged data, or by date and location data encoded in the images.



Light-table view


In the zoomable/pannable view of individual images, users can select and save regions of interest. The apps’ URLs allow users to address regions of interest with an HTML roi parameter, like this example.



Image with selected regions of interest


The github pages for imageviewer hosts an example installation of the catalogs.html app for viewing images by catalog.
